scheme_name: Bar Coding / Quality Certification Reimbursement Scheme
overview: The Bar Coding / Quality Certification Reimbursement Scheme provides financial assistance to micro enterprises for adopting bar codes and quality certification. It offers reimbursement of 80% of one-time registration fees and annual recurring fees for the first three years for bar code adoption, and financial assistance on annual membership or subscription fees for selling products via e-commerce platforms. The scheme aims to enhance market access and competitiveness of micro enterprises through standardized product identification and quality assurance.
objectives: Promote adoption of Bar Code among micro enterprises
Provide financial assistance for bar code registration and renewal
Support micro enterprises in selling products via e-commerce platforms
Enhance market access and product visibility
Encourage use of modern packaging techniques
Facilitate participation in trade fairs and exhibitions
Conduct national workshops and seminars on business development
eligibility: Manufacturing / Service sector MSEs having valid Udyam Registration (UR) Certificate. Micro enterprises which have UDYAM Registration and also have registration with GS1 India for use of Bar Codes.
benefits: Financial assistance of 80% of one-time registration fee and annual recurring fee (for first three years) for adoption of Bar Code (Micro enterprises). Financial assistance on annual membership fee/subscription fee/contingency expenses (photography, cataloguing, advertising, etc.) for selling their products or services by Micro Enterprises. 80% subsidy on built up space rent paid for General & 100% for SC/ST/Women/PH/Aspirational District and 100% contingency expenditure for Trade fairs (Micro & Small Enterprises).
financial_support: The scheme provides financial assistance of 80% of one-time registration fee and annual recurring fee (for first three years) for adoption of Bar Code by micro enterprises, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,650/-. For e-commerce platform adoption, financial assistance of 75% of paid amount by Micro Enterprises is provided, subject to a maximum of Rs. 25,000/- per financial year. For trade fairs, 80% subsidy on built up space rent is provided for General category and 100% for SC/ST/Women/PH/Aspirational District, along with 100% contingency expenditure (subject to maximum Rs. 25,000/-).
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to Rs. 50,650/- for Bar Code registration (one-time and annual recurring fees for first three years)
application_process: 1. Confirm eligibility as a micro enterprise with valid Udyam Registration and GS1 India registration for Bar Code. 2. Obtain application form from the Director/HOO of the respective MSME Development Institute (MSME-DI). 3. Fill in the application form with details of the micro enterprise, amount paid for one-time and annual recurring fees to GS1 India. 4. Attach required documents: attested copy of cash receipt, license from GS1 India, pre-receipted bills in triplicate, copy of UDYAM Registration, affidavit, and undertaking. 5. Submit the application to the Director/HOO of the MSME-DI. 6. Await verification and reimbursement processing.
required_documents: Attested copy of Cash Receipt for total amount (one-time registration fee &/or annual recurring fee) paid to GS1 India for use of Bar Codes
Attested copy of license received from GS1 India for use of Bar Code
Pre-receipted bill (in original) in triplicate for amount to be reimbursed for one-time registration fees
Pre-receipted bill (in original) in triplicate for amount to be reimbursed for annual recurring fee for 1st three years
Copy of UDYAM Registration of the micro enterprise
Affidavit as per Annexure - III regarding current status of the enterprise
Undertaking as per Annexure-IV (concerning non-receipt of similar financial assistance from any other organization and/or from Office of the DC (MSME))
contact_details: Head Quarters: Joint Director, O/o DC(MSME), Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi. Tel: 011-23061198 Email: pms[dot]division[at]dcmsme[dot]gov[dot]in
caveats: Only micro enterprises with valid Udyam Registration and GS1 India registration for Bar Code are eligible
Reimbursement is limited to 80% of one-time registration fee and annual recurring fee for the first three years
Maximum reimbursement for Bar Code is capped at Rs. 50,650/-
For e-commerce platform, assistance is limited to 75% of paid amount, subject to maximum Rs. 25,000/- per financial year
An MSE is allowed reimbursement for a maximum of 2 events in a year under the scheme's trade fair component
